'DAY OF RECKONING FOR DOLOMITE BEACH PROJECT HAS ARRIVED'

Inihain ni Bicol Saro Rep. Terry Ridon ang House Resolution No. 56 na layong hikayatin ang Kamara na imbestigahan ang Manila Bay Rehabilitation Program, kabilang ang Manila Baywalk Dolomite Beach.

Kasunod ito ng ulat ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) na lumala ang baha sa Maynila dahil sa proyekto.

"It is nothing but a criminal wastage of public funds — P389 million that could have been far better spent on sewage treatment plants and other engineering interventions grounded in science and sustainability," sabi ng kongresista.
